recent.text: 🚨 OFFICIAL: Jamir Watkins underwent successful ACL reconstruction surgery on his left knee, sustained during Summer League. The 2025 43rd overall pick is sidelined for recovery.
🚨 OFFICIAL: Neemias Queta signs a $56M extension with the Celtics.

The Cavs had LeBron in the building once and still couldn't close. Cleveland's front office failed when it mattered most. Warriors came closer to landing him than the team that drafted him.

Tell me I'm wrong.
🚨 OFFICIAL: Spurs target Kroupi out 3-4 months with foot injury.
🚨 OFFICIAL: 76ers hire Mike Gansey as President of Basketball Operations.
👀 Jalen Duren and the Pistons remain in stalemate on a contract extension, with talks expected to continue deep into August, per Shams Charania. Both sides dug in on their positions.

Draymond Green re-signing with Golden State while LeBron James didn't join proves the Warriors still have enough to compete. But a 1-year deal screams uncertainty about whether this core can actually win a title. Golden State is betting on hope, not a championship roster.
📰 REPORT: Mavericks have opened extension talks with Dereck Lively II.
📰 REPORT: 76ers looking to trade Johni Broome to create roster space for Kentavious Caldwell-Pope signing, per Jake Fischer.
📰 REPORT: Draymond Green and Warriors expected to agree on new deal this week, per Jake Fischer. Structures include one-year deal near $27.7M.
📰 REPORT: James Harden and Cavaliers expected to agree on deal lasting no more than two years, per Jake Fischer.
📰 REPORT: Bucks viewed as favorites to land Peyton Watson in sign-and-trade, per Jake Fischer. Nuggets seeking at least two first-round picks.
📰 REPORT: Dave Joerger has agreed to become lead assistant coach for the Denver Nuggets under head coach David Adelman, per ESPN.
📰 REPORT: Heat, Nuggets and Cavaliers among teams interested in DeMar DeRozan, per Shams Charania.
LeBron took less money to maybe commute by helicopter between New York and Philadelphia. That's not sacrifice, that's ego. A real max player signs the full deal and figures out logistics later.
